name: pk-finance-cron
description: Punctual trigger for the PK Finance scrapers. GitHub's own cron runs this repo's jobs 4-6 hours late and drops most fires; this calls repository_dispatch on time instead.

scripts.secrets: node ./node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js secret put GITHUB_TOKEN && node ./node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js secret put API_KEYS
